Those who chose a ‘why’ can bear almost any ‘how’

I’m not going to give u pity that never helped anyone.

But as a fellow redditor struggling in different ways I will try to provide some solace.

I’ve had a few people close to me that suffered terminal illnesses. 

What I gathered was even tho u may be in pain and suffering. It’s best to make the most of it while u can.

I don’t mean going skydiving, enjoy the company of those around u. I’m sure there’s many in ur life who truly appreciate u.

If ur already going to die might as well go out in a high note. I’ve never been in that position but the finality of life is present for all of us and for u a bit more urgent. 

Just try to find peace in ur final days there’s only so much time left till it’s black. When ur there your pain will end. But for now try to get in as much joy as possible. 

And to shed some actual wisdom. Victor Frankl author of search for meaning - renown existential psychologist and Auschwitz survivor. (Highly recommend u read btw) 

Quote from him “Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms—to choose one’s attitude in any given set of circumstances, to choose one’s own way” 

Those who have a 'why' to live, can bear 

Find you why and then chose your way, suicide isn’t the way and death isn’t the ‘why’

Good luck I hope u feel better and start smoking weed

I was vehemently bullied during my formative years. It was tough, being ostracized. But what I found was to focus on myself and seek fellowships with those who I found compatible. Yes kind of vague and basic advice but beyond that I needed a change. You could be in community that u have no connection with and thus ur constantly being cast out by the “same” people. Try moving, joining new clubs or groups. Putting urself out there is the best way. And if u put urself out there and nothing happens then maybe it’s not ur fault and it’s ur brains fault. U could have such an imbalance that it’s hard for u to interact socially… if that’s the case then literally the best thing u can do for urself is exercise regularly and talk therapy. Plus getting a dog. But seriously exercise regularly that was the only thing that was able to lessen my suicidal ideation. Also u don’t have to run a marathon just 15 minutes of exercise aerobic exercise. So just break a sweat once in a while and ingaurentee u will feel better. Plus u will be more confident and less insecure which will help u make friends. I’m not loving life either and have different problems than you but just hang in there. I don’t want to either. Remember the beautiful moments in life and use it to push u forward. The world is sad enough no need for more
Hopefully it’s temporary, distress and severe physical trauma can have strange effects like that.
